Game Overview

Animal Ice Cream Shop is a animal game built around delight in a summer adventure at Animal Ice Cream Shop. Help the charming panda, Miumiu, manage a bustling seaside ice cream stand. Mix creativity with speedy service to craft delicious treats, satisfy adorable animal patrons, and master new recipes in a vibrant, sun-kissed setting.
